name: dlm-faith
description: Read the King James Bible word for word, hear any chapter read aloud, and find verses and a short prayer for how you feel, inside the chat.

interface.longDescription:
Read the King James Bible word for word, hear any chapter read aloud, and find verses and a short prayer for how you feel, without leaving your chat.

Scripture, exactly. Ask for a verse or a chapter and DLM Faith shows the text from a checked source, with its reference and a link, never a paraphrase. Search for words you half remember. Open a chapter in a reader with verse numbers and turn the page to the next one. Every chapter can be heard, read by a LibriVox volunteer, and many New Testament chapters also by AI narrators.

For how you feel. Tell DLM Faith you are anxious, grieving, restless, discouraged, tired or thankful, and it brings the verses people turn to and a prayer of one to three minutes, read by an AI narrator with the words on screen as they are read.

A prayer each day. Each weekday has its Daily Light, a verse and a short thought, and the morning prayers, evening prayers, sleep readings and Bible stories each offer a different one each day.

To listen. Faith radio and sacred music from 29 stations, DLM Faith's own songs, and faith talk shows.

Also includes the Book of Mormon (1920 edition) and the Pearl of Great Price (1902 edition). The narrators are AI voices. DLM Faith does not replace pastoral, medical or crisis care. DLM Faith is not affiliated with or endorsed by The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
capabilities: Read any chapter of the King James Bible, word for word
Quote verses exactly, with reference and link
Search the scriptures for words you remember
Find verses and a short prayer for how you feel
Hear today's prayer, a different one each day
Guided prayers read by AI narrators, with the words on screen
Fall asleep to scripture and evening prayers
The Book of Mormon and Pearl of Great Price, 1920s editions
defaultPrompt: I'm feeling anxious. What should I read and pray?
Read Psalm 23 and play it aloud

positive.description: Verses and a prayer for a feeling
positive.prompt: I'm feeling anxious tonight. What should I read, and is there a prayer I can listen to?
positive.expected_behavior: Replies gently, quotes Philippians 4:6-7 and other verses exactly as the tool returns them (King James Version), then opens the player on today's prayer for anxiety. The player names the narrator as an AI narrator and shows the prayer's words as they are read. Audio starts when the reviewer taps play.

positive.prompt: Read Psalm 23 and play it aloud
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the reader on Psalm 23 in the King James Version with verse numbers and a play button for its recording. The reviewer can turn to Psalm 24 in the reader. The reply does not repeat the whole chapter.

Names today's prayer and today's Daily Light for the reviewer's own date, quotes the Daily Light's verse exactly (King James Version), and opens the player on today's prayer, read by an AI narrator with its words on screen. Another day gives a different prayer.

positive.description: Find a verse from remembered words
positive.prompt: Where is the verse about considering the lilies of the field?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives Matthew 6:28 and Luke 12:27 with their exact King James text and links to their pages on dlmfaith.com.

positive.prompt: Play some sacred music while I study
positive.expected_behavior: Opens a player on a live sacred or instrumental station (for example Abiding Radio, Instrumental), or a row of station cards to choose from. Tapping play starts the live stream.

negative.description: Giving: DLM Faith collects nothing in ChatGPT
negative.expected_behavior: No DLM Faith tool is called and nothing is offered for sale or collected. ChatGPT says this can't be done here.

negative.description: Writing a sermon is the model's work, not a tool's
negative.prompt: Write me a sermon about patience
negative.expected_behavior: No DLM Faith render tool is called. ChatGPT may write it, and if it quotes scripture it may fetch the exact text with get_passage.

negative.prompt: Book me a table for two tonight
negative.expected_behavior: No DLM Faith tool is called.

review.commerce_description: DLM Faith in ChatGPT does not sell products, subscriptions or services, does not ask for or collect gifts, and does not process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: the King James Bible, Book of Mormon and Pearl of Great Price word for word, with every chapter read aloud; verses and a prayer for seven feelings; a prayer for each day; sleep readings and Bible stories; faith radio, sacred music and faith shows.
